content: pamac (manjaro/pamac README, verified): libpamac core + Gtk4 pamac-manager GUI + CLI + pamac-tray update-notifier + gnome-shell updates indicator. Features: search/browse installed-or-all, AUR via AUR helpers, install/remove/update transactions, flatpak optional, polkit pkexec escalation, transaction preview (conflicts, install size). octopi (Qt equivalent): same shape with commit/file browsing, repo refresh, AUR via yay/pikaur. Table stakes for an Arch package GUI: search, installed filter, updatable list + trigger update, AUR column, transaction confirmation preview, pkexec.
